publicBoundaryChecks.name: relocated public validation and declared inspection
public package exports no raw schema or semantic entry
all pinned schema bytes and local refs travel with package
main entry import and validation do not call effect APIs
public declarations typecheck without checkout dependencies
caller inputs are repeatable and not mutated
JS accessors and cycles are rejected before evaluation
unknown kind/version remain explicit unsupported without raw echo
duplicates and malformed YAML fail closed
diagnostics redact extra properties and preserve truncation failure
unsafe workspace selections and empty root never fall back to cwd
public source planning rejects unsafe locators without exposing values
root symlinks, non-regular files, invalid UTF-8 and byte limits reject
all 109 maintained example manifests pass the relocated public API
pure import closure stays within the package and reviewed pure dependencies
frozen prototype sources, locks and corpus were not modified

coverage: Catalog includes internal semantic-fragment/local-schema regressions and the read-only workspace facade. It does not mean all seven operations are a public API or complete project semantics.
